title: Lik Ngai Tai Khamyang: Elementary Primer and Grammar of the Tai Khamyang Language
author: Chao Aong Ching Shyam & Phung Lai Khamyang
description: Foundational pedagogical grammar, syllabary, and lexicon compiled specifically for the revitalization of Tai Khamyang by community elders and native scholars at Sapekhar and Pawaimukh, published by Phung Lai Khamyang on Poy Mau Tai 2109.

sentences.free_translation_as: সহজ তাই খাময়াং পুথি আৰু ভাষাৰ ব্যাকৰণ।
sentences.speaker: Chao Aong Ching Shyam
sentences.notes: Title heading of the primer published by Phung Lai Khamyang.
